evidence_summary: Apellis became a wholly owned Biogen subsidiary after each common share was converted into $41.00 cash plus one contingent value right worth up to an additional $4.00 before Nasdaq removal.
adjudication_note: Explicit per-share cash and contingent consideration makes the exchange removal transaction mechanics, not a negative delisting event.

evidence_summary: Forian completed a tender-offer merger in which each outstanding common share was converted into the right to receive $2.17 cash before delisting.
adjudication_note: The Form 25 is a consequence of a paid acquisition, not loss of value through an adverse listing action.

evidence_summary: Kezar became a wholly owned subsidiary after a completed tender offer for $6.955 cash per common share plus one contingent value right, followed by merger-related delisting.
adjudication_note: The listing exit follows explicit common-holder consideration and cannot be used as a negative delisting label.

evidence_summary: Ashford's going-dark transaction cashed out record holders with fewer than 10,000 shares at $5.00 per pre-split share and then delisted and deregistered the remaining privately held common stock.
adjudication_note: Market access and reporting terminate, but small holders receive explicit cash and the company continues privately; this is not bankruptcy or common-equity death.

evidence_summary: Aditxt implemented a proportionate reverse split primarily to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance, with exercise and conversion terms adjusted in line with the split.
adjudication_note: A later risk disclosure mentioning pre-funded warrants is not an executed financing and must not promote the split to A.

evidence_summary: WeTrade implemented a one-for-185 reverse split to regain Nasdaq's minimum-bid requirement, proportionately combining issued common shares.
adjudication_note: The action is a listing-remediation split; later delisting failure is a separate consequence and no executed financing was identified in the review window.

evidence_summary: Webuy disclosed a registered direct offering of 5,372,792 ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 15,640,447 additional shares at about $0.1756 before its reverse-split remediation and eventual Nasdaq reinstatement.
adjudication_note: The financing and warrant capacity establish material dilution context; successful relisting prevents treating the episode as terminal.

evidence_summary: HOOKIPA stockholders approved both the asset sale and the company's Plan of Dissolution, authorizing the company to liquidate and dissolve.
adjudication_note: Approval establishes a terminal-company path, but completion and the final common-holder distribution are not yet proven, so the event remains below S.

evidence_summary: FOXO's common stock was suspended by NYSE American after falling below the $0.10 low-price standard and moved to OTC trading; no bankruptcy or liquidation proceeding was disclosed.
adjudication_note: The detector's bankruptcy/liquidation family is unsupported; retain the listing-only event as a mismatch control.

evidence_summary: ThredUp voluntarily delisted and planned Form 15 deregistration; the filing disclosed no court insolvency, liquidation plan or old-common cancellation.
adjudication_note: Deregistration alone does not verify the detected bankruptcy/liquidation family.

evidence_summary: Thunder Power disclosed an unresolved Nasdaq delisting determination for minimum-bid and market-value deficiencies, not an insolvency petition or liquidation.
adjudication_note: The evidence supports only a listing-compliance action and cannot verify bankruptcy.

evidence_summary: Global Blockchain Acquisition announced redemption of its IPO public shares after it failed to complete a business combination by the SPAC deadline.
adjudication_note: Public holders receive trust-account redemption; the SPAC lifecycle event is not bankruptcy or zero-recovery equity death.

evidence_summary: Luokung disclosed a Nasdaq panel decision affirming delisting and suspension; the filing did not disclose bankruptcy, liquidation or common-share cancellation.
adjudication_note: A genuine listing loss remains a false bankruptcy/liquidation detection when no insolvency evidence exists.

evidence_summary: Lytus disclosed Nasdaq suspension followed by planned OTC Pink trading, with no bankruptcy petition or liquidation plan in the cited evidence.
adjudication_note: The detector family is unsupported even though an adverse listing event occurred.

evidence_summary: Goldenstone faced suspension and delisting for failure to comply with Nasdaq's SPAC business-combination deadline rule, not because of bankruptcy or liquidation.
adjudication_note: The listing-rule failure is not an insolvency proceeding.

evidence_summary: Patria Acquisition's annual report contained only hypothetical trust-account bankruptcy risk language and did not disclose that a bankruptcy or winding-up petition had actually been filed.
adjudication_note: Conditional risk disclosure must not be converted into an actual bankruptcy event.

evidence_summary: FutureTech II disclosed a Nasdaq delisting process tied to SPAC listing deadlines and market-value compliance and elected not to appeal; no insolvency case was disclosed.
adjudication_note: The primary evidence supports a SPAC listing failure, not bankruptcy or liquidation.

evidence_summary: First Financial Northwest completed the previously announced sale of substantially all bank assets and liabilities and planned delisting and deregistration; it did not file bankruptcy or adopt a liquidation plan in this source.
adjudication_note: A completed asset sale and reporting exit cannot verify the detected bankruptcy/liquidation family without separate dissolution or equity-death evidence.

evidence_summary: Asahi Kasei controlled more than 90 percent of Calliditas after its paid offers, declared the offers unconditional and initiated compulsory redemption before the listing exit.
adjudication_note: The exchange exit is acquisition mechanics after a paid tender offer, not an independently negative delisting or common-equity death event.

evidence_summary: Vitru's ADS exit followed a completed merger whose filing expressly directs holders to the disclosed merger consideration.
adjudication_note: The delisting is a merger consequence with consideration, so it is not a negative listing-loss label.

evidence_summary: Alchemy Investments Acquisition Corp. failed to complete an initial business combination within the SPAC's 36-month deadline and became subject to Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: The security's exit is a contractual SPAC deadline outcome, not an operating-company distress or adverse common-equity signal.

evidence_summary: Alchemy Investments Acquisition Corp. failed to complete an initial business combination within the SPAC's 36-month deadline and became subject to Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: The unit's exit is the same SPAC deadline chain as ALCYF and must not be treated as a second negative corporate event.

evidence_summary: Tritium disclosed voluntary administration of specified Australian subsidiaries while other subsidiaries continued to operate; the filing contains no reverse-share-split action.
adjudication_note: Reject only the detected reverse-split label; preserve the separate subsidiary-administration fact in its proper event family.

evidence_summary: SHL voluntarily ended its Nasdaq ADR listing and SEC reporting to reduce its cost base while its ordinary shares continued to trade on the SIX Swiss Exchange.
adjudication_note: The U.S. listing exit is real, but continuing home-market liquidity makes this a venue-consolidation boundary rather than severe distress.

evidence_summary: Steel Partners voluntarily approved NYSE delisting and deregistration and expected its units to continue quotation on OTCQX.
adjudication_note: This verifies a loss of national-exchange access, not insolvency or terminal equity impairment.

evidence_summary: 1895 Bancorp chose to delist and deregister to reduce public-company compliance and accounting expense and intended to continue quotation on OTCQX.
adjudication_note: Cost-driven deregistration with an OTC continuation is a valid but non-terminal listing event.

evidence_summary: TC Bancshares voluntarily left Nasdaq and suspended periodic reporting while expecting uninterrupted OTCQX quotation under the same symbol.
adjudication_note: National-exchange access ended, but continued OTC quotation keeps the event below a material-distress grade.

evidence_summary: Cullman Bancorp intended to delist from Nasdaq, terminate Exchange Act registration and seek OTCQX quotation.
adjudication_note: The listing exit is verified while OTC continuity was planned; no severe corporate outcome is established.

evidence_summary: Grupo Exito's ADS exit was designed to concentrate its float and liquidity in Colombia, which the company described as its natural market.
adjudication_note: This is geographic liquidity consolidation, not a distress-driven equity impairment.

evidence_summary: Sendas planned to delist its ADSs, after which they were expected to begin trading immediately over the counter before deregistration.
adjudication_note: Immediate OTC continuity makes this a reporting-and-venue exit boundary, not a terminal event.

evidence_summary: Orange planned to delist and deregister its NYSE ADSs while maintaining its Euronext Paris listing and a sponsored Level 1 ADR program in the U.S. over-the-counter market.
adjudication_note: The NYSE exit is verified, but home-market and OTC ADR access continue.

evidence_summary: Chesapeake's 1-for-200 reverse split was intended to restore NYSE minimum-price compliance and proportionally reduced both outstanding and authorized common shares.
adjudication_note: The action is real, but the cited filing supports proportional listing remediation rather than a financing or dilution chain.

evidence_summary: Elevai filed a charter amendment effecting a 1-for-200 reverse stock split on November 27, 2024.
adjudication_note: The split is verified, but no executed financing or post-split dilution mechanism was established in the reviewed window.

evidence_summary: Exela filed the charter amendment effecting a 1-for-200 reverse stock split on May 12, 2023.
adjudication_note: The filing verifies the split itself but not a contemporaneous executed financing chain.

evidence_summary: Benessere Capital Acquisition effected a reverse split and reduced its authorized common shares to 200 million, with fractional shares rounded up.
adjudication_note: The reviewed source verifies a proportional capital-structure action but not a financing-driven dilution chain.

evidence_summary: Ridge Technology's 1-for-150 reverse share split affected all shareholders uniformly and did not change any holder's ownership percentage.
adjudication_note: The source explicitly establishes a proportional split and provides no evidence of dilution in the event window.

evidence_summary: American Oncology Network chose Nasdaq delisting and deregistration after citing no active market or analyst coverage and high continuing compliance costs.
adjudication_note: Unlike ordinary venue consolidation, the filing documents the absence of an active market and analyst coverage, making the exit materially adverse but not terminal.

evidence_summary: SciSparc's post-split interim statements identify the March 2021 financing round and exercises of November 2020 and pre-funded warrants in the share-capital roll-forward.
adjudication_note: The split is connected to evidenced financing and warrant issuance/exercise, so it is more informative than an action-only split but remains below severe distress grades.

evidence_summary: A Nasdaq Hearings Panel determined to delist American Rebel for continued non-compliance with the $1 minimum bid-price rule; Nasdaq trading was suspended while the company planned OTCID and OTCQB quotation and remained an SEC registrant.
adjudication_note: The final panel outcome verifies a material forced listing loss, but continuing operations, SEC reporting and planned OTC access keep it below insolvency or equity-death grades.

evidence_summary: After an actual borrowing-base default, S&W Seed's secured lender delivered a UCC Article 9 sale notice covering collateral that represented substantially all company assets. On August 1 a buyer agreed to acquire the collateral, with cash proceeds paid to the lender.
adjudication_note: The detector's bankruptcy label is too broad, but creditor control over substantially all collateral after an actual default is independently a hard event. No bankruptcy petition or old-common cancellation supports S.

evidence_summary: Equity Commonwealth authorized a final $1.60 cash liquidating distribution before NYSE delisting and planned to convert each common share one-for-one into a beneficial-interest unit of a liquidating trust.
adjudication_note: The liquidation is real, but common holders received cash and continuing trust interests. It is neither bankruptcy nor zero-recovery equity death and must remain a B boundary.

evidence_summary: CBD's board approved delisting its ADSs after the NYSE below-criteria price notice, very limited ADS trading and high listing costs. Its common shares remained listed on B3, the principal market, and the sponsored ADS program continued.
adjudication_note: The U.S. venue exit is verified, but home-market liquidity and the ADS facility continued. Price noncompliance alone does not make this operating distress.

evidence_summary: Rubrik reported $429.4 million cash and $1.320 billion short-term investments and stated that these resources were sufficient for at least twelve months. The single-quarter EBIT-to-interest screen did not establish a payment default, covenant breach or liquidity event.
adjudication_note: A loss-based quarterly coverage ratio is not an event by itself. Retain only as a negative control unless LTM coverage, cash interest, covenant or payment evidence changes.

evidence_summary: Rubrik reported a $481.3 million stockholders' deficit, improved from $519.6 million at fiscal year-end, alongside $429.4 million cash and $1.320 billion short-term investments sufficient for at least twelve months.
adjudication_note: Negative book equity is factual, but the contemporaneous liquidity buffer and improving deficit make it a B accounting boundary rather than an acute distress label.

evidence_summary: Asana disclosed $78.3 million of available revolver capacity, $38.1 million outstanding under its secured facility and explicit compliance with all financial covenants at April 30, 2026.
adjudication_note: Explicit covenant compliance and undrawn capacity negate the detector's implied debt event; preserve the calculated ratio only for audit.

evidence_summary: Limoneira's lender twice deferred annual debt-service-coverage testing and deferred quarterly leverage testing through July 2027. Six-month operating cash use rose to $16.1 million while financing supplied $19.1 million.
adjudication_note: Repeated covenant-test relief plus operating cash use is materially adverse financing dependence, but it is not an actual default, acceleration or insolvency filing.

evidence_summary: Nutanix reported a $725.6 million stockholders' deficit but also $718.8 million cash, $1.299 billion short-term investments, no revolver borrowings and compliance with its leverage covenant. A subsequent $150 million AMD placement further increased liquidity.
adjudication_note: The deficit is real, but cash, investments, unused revolver capacity and covenant compliance make it an accounting boundary rather than a hard distress event.

evidence_summary: Nano Magic disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern, but the filing was nearly three months before the February 2021 price episode and no contemporaneous primary event was found.
adjudication_note: The return and volume observation remains discovery-only. A stale risk disclosure is not promoted into a dated causal event.

evidence_summary: Work Medical sold 22,055,096 Class A shares and 16,944,238 pre-funded warrants at $0.075 for $2.9 million gross proceeds, and disclosed that the pre-funded warrants had been exercised in full. A later filing added a $200 million at-the-market facility.
adjudication_note: The financing chain is material and verified, but its primary event date is September 25-26 rather than the later December price observation. Keep only the financing event for positive training.

evidence_summary: Ridgetech's March filing contained historical cash-flow comparisons but no new default, insolvency, enforcement, financing close or other hard event contemporaneous with the March 24 price observation. The reverse split occurred afterward.
adjudication_note: Do not backfill a cause from a later reverse split or an older ATM agreement. The price detector is not event truth.

evidence_summary: UTime proposed a 25-for-1 share consolidation and, after that consolidation, a tenfold increase in authorized share capital with subdivision and creation of billions of additional authorized ordinary shares. Shareholders approved the proposals on August 28.
adjudication_note: The same-date capital action is the event. Contract boilerplate in the annual report is explicitly excluded as a false default cause.

evidence_summary: Top Wealth announced pricing of a $10.8 million public offering of 27 million ordinary shares at $0.40 per share, compared with 29 million shares outstanding before the offering.
adjudication_note: The primary event is the October 11 offering pricing. The October 25 price observation is retained only as a linked consequence and is excluded from positive-event training.

evidence_summary: Jayud mutually terminated two acquisition agreements without disputes. No purchase price had been paid for one acquisition; for the other, the warehouse interest was returned and 1,704,851 consideration shares were cancelled.
adjudication_note: The filing does not establish a destructive financing, default or loss event. The later return remains discovery evidence only.

evidence_summary: Internet Gold implemented a court-approved arrangement under Israel's Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law; its Series C and D bonds were withdrawn from TASE clearing and Series D was delisted.
adjudication_note: The insolvency arrangement is a hard event, but the price observation is not the event date and the notice does not prove cancellation or zero recovery of old common equity.

evidence_summary: Presbia's SEC submission history ends with a Form 15-12B in May 2019 and contains no contemporaneous issuer filing or official action explaining the June 2021 price observation.
adjudication_note: Absence of a contemporaneous official cause prevents promotion of the price series into an event label.

evidence_summary: The SEC suspended trading in ECTE because current and accurate information was unavailable, noting that the issuer was a void Delaware corporation, delinquent in periodic filings since September 2016 and had no valid address.
adjudication_note: The SEC order is the primary dated event. The later price record is a consequence and does not independently qualify for A++ or S.

evidence_summary: Rediff's SEC submission history ends with a Form 15-12G in May 2016 and contains no contemporaneous issuer filing or official action explaining the November 2021 price observation.
adjudication_note: The price series alone cannot establish a new event years after deregistration.

evidence_summary: Skillsoft reported a $72.8 million shareholders' deficit, but also $115.6 million of unrestricted cash and cash equivalents and $28.9 million of quarterly operating cash inflow, with no substantial-doubt statement.
adjudication_note: The deficit is factual, but liquidity and positive operating cash flow prevent promotion into acute distress.

evidence_summary: ChargePoint's stockholders' equity moved from positive $21.3 million to a $9.1 million deficit during the quarter. It held $96.2 million of cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash and stated that available resources would satisfy requirements for at least twelve months, while acknowledging continued losses and financing dependence.
adjudication_note: The transition into negative equity is real, but management's twelve-month liquidity conclusion and absence of default keep it below A.

evidence_summary: HP reported a $144 million stockholders' deficit while holding $3.703 billion of cash, producing $1.309 billion of six-month operating cash flow and returning $1.0 billion through dividends and repurchases.
adjudication_note: Negative book equity is not distress when a profitable issuer is generating cash and deliberately returning capital.

evidence_summary: Red Robin reported a $106.7 million stockholders' deficit and $175.7 million drawn under its credit facility, but also approximately $40.8 million of liquidity, a 14.8% restaurant-level operating margin and reaffirmed full-year guidance.
adjudication_note: Leverage warrants monitoring, but the filing does not establish default, going concern failure or immediate financing distress.

evidence_summary: Antero Midstream had $808 million of available credit-facility capacity, expected its capital resources to cover requirements and dividends for at least twelve months, and declared its quarterly dividend.
adjudication_note: A near-zero cash balance is not a cash crisis when the issuer uses operating cash flow and a large available revolver as ordinary liquidity.

evidence_summary: Obsidian Energy guided to approximately C$225 million of funds flow, positive free cash flow and C$272 million of net debt, equal to about 1.2 times annualized funds flow.
adjudication_note: The cash-to-current-debt screen ignores an energy producer's operating funds flow, revolving facility and ordinary debt-management model.

evidence_summary: Antero Resources reported $1.3 billion of available borrowing capacity and expected operating cash flow plus available credit to cover normal operations, debt service and capital expenditure for at least twelve months.
adjudication_note: The detector ignores the issuer's revolver-based treasury model and explicit twelve-month liquidity conclusion.

evidence_summary: Antero Resources used operating cash flow and its unsecured revolving facility as primary liquidity sources; the low cash balance did not represent a missed payment, covenant breach or going-concern event.
adjudication_note: This is a second quarterly observation of the same non-event metric pattern, not a new distress event.

evidence_summary: Ring Energy explicitly stated that it keeps cash as low as possible to reduce debt. It had $137 million of unused credit, was in compliance with all credit covenants and had no default or event of default.
adjudication_note: This filing directly negates the detector's implied cash crisis and is a strong treasury-policy control.

evidence_summary: Iron Horse was a SPAC whose business-combination trust proceeds were segregated from working capital and whose sponsor loans were payable at a completed combination or from non-trust excess proceeds.
adjudication_note: A generic operating cash-to-current-debt ratio is invalid for pre-combination SPAC trust accounting.

evidence_summary: VirnetX reported quarterly revenue of $5 thousand versus $302.6 million a year earlier because the comparison quarter contained a one-time $454.0 million Apple patent-litigation collection.
adjudication_note: The numerical collapse is real but reflects the roll-off of extraordinary legal proceeds, not collapse of recurring operating revenue.

evidence_summary: Inhibikase reported that grant revenue increased 111% to $260,501 in 2023 from $123,440 in 2022, contradicting the detector's near-100% revenue-collapse implication.
adjudication_note: The filing's relevant revenue measure increased; a near-zero or differently mapped Sharadar field is not promoted into an event.

evidence_summary: Autolus held $95.8 million of cash and $420.8 million of marketable securities and concluded that these resources were sufficient for at least twelve months. The filing did not substantiate the detector's extreme gross-margin event as a hard fundamental shock.
adjudication_note: Pre-commercial and launch-stage revenue denominators can create extreme margin deltas; retain only the point-in-time liquidity facts.

evidence_summary: TotalEnergies reported first-quarter 2026 revenue from sales of $49.516 billion, up 3% from $47.899 billion a year earlier, and net income attributable to TotalEnergies of $5.810 billion.
adjudication_note: The official quarterly disclosure shows positive year-over-year revenue growth, so the near-100% Sharadar revenue-collapse observation is a field-mapping error rather than an event.

evidence_summary: Verastem reported quarterly revenue of $2 thousand versus $78.647 million a year earlier; the comparison quarter included $70.0 million from the sale of the COPIKTRA license and related assets, and product sales ended after the September 2020 transaction.
adjudication_note: The numerical collapse is real, but most of the prior-year revenue was a one-time asset and license sale rather than recurring operating revenue.

evidence_summary: FIEE reported first-quarter net sales of $125 versus $639,893 a year earlier. Legacy cable-modem and networking-product sales fell to zero while initial SaaS revenue was $125, which management attributed to the strategic exit from legacy hardware and a pivot to AI and big-data SaaS services.
adjudication_note: This is a genuine near-total loss of the legacy revenue base during a business-model transition, not a missing-data artifact; the new SaaS stream was still immaterial at the reporting date.

evidence_summary: Aytu reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2023 gross profit of $18.6 million, or 60% of net revenue, compared with $14.8 million, or 54%, a year earlier.
adjudication_note: The official period-end earnings release directly contradicts the detector: both gross profit and gross margin increased year over year.

evidence_summary: Clear Channel Outdoor reports revenue, direct operating expenses and segment Adjusted EBITDA rather than a conventional product gross margin. In 2022, Airports revenue rose to $256.4 million from $160.3 million and segment Adjusted EBITDA rose to $60.9 million from $36.9 million.
adjudication_note: A generic gross-margin field is not comparable for this lease-heavy advertising model; the issuer's reported segment economics do not substantiate the detector's extreme collapse.

evidence_summary: Akoustis reported quarterly revenue of $636 thousand and cost of revenue of $1.649 million, producing negative gross profit of $1.013 million versus positive gross profit of $207 thousand a year earlier. The cost increase accompanied early RF-product manufacturing and included direct labor, materials, net-realizable-value adjustments and facility costs.
adjudication_note: The reported margin collapse is real, but it occurred on a sub-$1 million revenue base during manufacturing scale-up and is retained as a boundary rather than promoted to insolvency severity.

evidence_summary: Aurora Cannabis reported Q4 gross margin before fair-value adjustments of negative 96% after a $91.0 million inventory impairment, while adjusted gross margin excluding inventory impairment and depreciation improved to 50% from 43% in Q3. Total inventory impairment for the period was $135.1 million.
adjudication_note: The reported collapse captures a large inventory write-down and market-demand reset, but adjusted operating gross margin improved; models must separate impairment severity from recurring unit economics.

evidence_summary: Kura Sushi reported quarterly sales of $2.812 million versus $16.955 million, restaurant operating costs of $7.916 million and an operating loss of $8.028 million after all 25 restaurants were temporarily closed on March 18, 2020 because of COVID-19; only seven had reopened at reduced capacity by May 31.
adjudication_note: This is a genuine and severe operating-margin shock caused by mandated pandemic closures, but the filing does not establish a hard insolvency event.

evidence_summary: Cantaloupe completed a cash merger in which each eligible common share was converted into the right to receive $11.20 before Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: The exchange exit is paid-merger mechanics, not an adverse delisting or common-equity death event.

evidence_summary: Peakstone Realty Trust completed a cash merger in which each eligible common share was converted into the right to receive $21.00 before NYSE delisting.
adjudication_note: Explicit per-share cash consideration makes the delisting a corporate-action control rather than a severe negative event.

evidence_summary: Canoo and its filing subsidiaries commenced Chapter 7 liquidation; a court-appointed trustee would assume control over the debtors' assets and liabilities and eliminate management's authority.
adjudication_note: Chapter 7 liquidation is a severe terminal-company event, but the filing does not explicitly establish old-common cancellation or zero recovery; keep below S until that equity outcome is proven.

evidence_summary: Bio-Path was delisted after failing Nasdaq's $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirement; trading was scheduled to move to the OTC market and the company did not appeal.
adjudication_note: The filing proves a serious listing-capital deficiency but not bankruptcy or liquidation; reject the detected family and preserve the mismatch as a control.

evidence_summary: Greenwave implemented a one-for-110 reverse stock split to increase its per-share price and regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid requirement.
adjudication_note: The split and listing pressure are real, but a reverse split does not by itself prove dilution, insolvency or equity death.

evidence_summary: Coterra completed an all-stock merger in which each eligible common share was converted into 0.70 Devon common shares before NYSE delisting.
adjudication_note: Holders received listed acquirer shares; the exchange exit is merger mechanics rather than an adverse delisting event.

evidence_summary: Carnival unified its dual-listed structure; each eligible Carnival plc share and each CUK ADS was exchanged one-for-one for Carnival Corporation Ltd. common shares before CUK delisting.
adjudication_note: The delisting reflects a one-for-one listed-share exchange and corporate simplification, not destruction of holder value.

evidence_summary: CERo disclosed that Nasdaq would suspend trading after denying continued listing for a stockholders' equity deficiency; part of a planned financing became conditional on continued listing and the company was reviewing cash resources and alternatives.
adjudication_note: The price-volume break has a contemporaneous official cause, but the hard label belongs to the listing and financing event; exclude the price proxy from independent-event training.

evidence_item: Plan of Dissolution
evidence_summary: Hyzon's board adopted a plan for complete liquidation and dissolution and sought approval to assign substantially all assets for the benefit of creditors after its strategic-alternatives review.
adjudication_note: The board-adopted terminal plan and creditor assignment support A++, but stockholder approval was still pending and any common-holder distribution remained unknown, so S is not established.

evidence_summary: After a one-for-110 reverse split reduced SOBR to 316,042 outstanding shares, the company entered an $8.2 million private placement for 2,024,691 units with Series A warrants and reset-linked Series B warrants permitting millions of additional shares.
adjudication_note: The severe assessment belongs to the financing chain disclosed five days later, not to the reverse split alone; exclude the split proxy from hard-label training and do not elevate financing size alone to A++.

evidence_summary: Immediately before Chanson's one-for-100 split, issued and outstanding Class A shares had reached 363,907,905, including 132,070,000 issued shares reserved for its at-the-market program, compared with 38,907,905 outstanding at the start of 2026.
adjudication_note: The material fact is realized share expansion and ATM-linked inventory, not the mechanical consolidation; keep the reverse-split proxy out of independent hard-label training.

evidence_item: Registered Direct Offering; Share Consolidation
evidence_summary: Before Meiwu's second reverse split in roughly one year became trading-effective, it closed a registered direct offering of 6,999,996 pre-split shares and equal warrants; the variable zero-price exercise formula could increase warrant shares to 83,999,952 pre-split shares.
adjudication_note: The A boundary requires the preceding realized financing, variable warrant formula and repeated remediation; the one-for-100 split alone would remain B and is excluded as an independent hard label.

evidence_summary: Li Bang implemented a one-for-100 reverse split primarily to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance; the contemporaneous evidence does not establish a priced or realized financing transaction.
adjudication_note: A generic shelf prospectus is not proof of financing; without a priced or completed issuance, this remains a listing-compliance split rather than an A-grade dilution chain.

evidence_item: Recent Developments; Capitalization; Dilution
evidence_summary: Zeta's March 2026 one-for-100 split followed a November 2024 one-for-100 split and an August 2025 one-for-25 split, while repeated convertible-note, pre-funded-warrant, share and unit issuances produced a large continuing warrant and conversion overhang.
adjudication_note: The A assessment requires the repeated failed price remediation and documented conversion/warrant chain; the split alone is not a hard label, and financing magnitude does not establish A++ or S without a terminal old-common outcome.

evidence_item: Consolidation of Ordinary Shares
evidence_summary: WORK Medical implemented a second one-for-100 consolidation only 69 days after its first; shares had expanded from approximately 1.036 million immediately after the October consolidation to approximately 122.0 million immediately before the December consolidation.
adjudication_note: The A boundary is the documented 118-fold share re-expansion and repeated failed remediation, not either mechanical split by itself; keep the reverse-split proxy out of independent hard-label training.

evidence_summary: Farmer Brothers' common shares were acquired for approximately $28.3 million in a completed cash merger before Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: The exchange exit is paid merger mechanics, not an adverse delisting or common-equity death event.

evidence_summary: Terns Pharmaceuticals' eligible common shares were converted into the right to receive the tender-offer price in Merck's completed acquisition before Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: Explicit merger consideration makes this a transaction-control example rather than a negative delisting label.

evidence_summary: Danimer Scientific's NYSE trading suspension followed a failure to maintain at least $15 million of average market capitalization, not a bankruptcy or liquidation filing.
adjudication_note: A later debt acceleration does not retroactively turn the December listing event into bankruptcy; reject the detected family.

evidence_summary: Fresh2's Nasdaq suspension followed failure to regain compliance with periodic filing requirements; the company expected Pink Market trading and intended to complete the delayed reports.
adjudication_note: The primary filing proves a reporting-delinquency delisting, not bankruptcy or liquidation.

evidence_summary: iLearningEngines and an affiliated holding company filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions and continued operating as debtors in possession.
adjudication_note: The petition establishes severe insolvency proceedings, but no confirmed plan or court order in the reviewed evidence proves cancellation or zero recovery for old common; keep below S.

evidence_summary: Molecular Templates' board approved a full wind-down, appointed a distressed-business specialist as sole director and officer, and stated that it did not expect security holders to receive value.
adjudication_note: The terminal wind-down and explicit no-value expectation support A++, but an expectation is not a confirmed cancellation order or final zero-recovery outcome, so S is not established.

evidence_summary: Sangamo received a Nasdaq delisting determination after failing to regain minimum-bid compliance and becoming ineligible for another cure period; its common stock transitioned to OTCQB while it pursued an appeal.
adjudication_note: This is a genuine forced exchange exit with OTC continuity, not a merger control and not common-equity death.

evidence_item: Share Combination; Private Placements
evidence_summary: Founder Group's one-for-100 split followed 196,068 post-split-equivalent shares acquired through completed prepaid purchases and a $16.07 million secured convertible note resetting at 82.5% of the lowest ten-day VWAP, against 854,310 Class A shares outstanding at the report date.
adjudication_note: The A assessment requires the realized prepaid share issuance and variable-price secured note; the compliance split alone remains a B-type mechanical event and is excluded from independent hard-label training.

evidence_item: Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement
evidence_summary: After Paranovus' one-for-100 reverse split, the company disclosed that it had sold 5,880,052 Class A shares on a post-split-adjusted basis through the ATM agreement before terminating it.
adjudication_note: The hard signal is the realized post-split-adjusted ATM issuance, not the proportional consolidation; exclude the split proxy as an independent training event.

evidence_summary: United Homes Group's completed merger converted each eligible common share into the right to receive $1.18 cash before Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: Explicit per-share cash consideration makes the exchange exit merger mechanics rather than an adverse delisting.

evidence_item: Stockholder-approved Class A Conversion
evidence_summary: Clearway Energy simplified its public share structure by automatically converting each Class A share one-for-one into a Class C share that began NYSE trading as the Class A line was suspended.
adjudication_note: Holders retained equivalent listed common shares and relative public voting power; the ticker-line removal is not a loss event.

evidence_item: VALOR-CKD topline results
evidence_summary: Tricida disclosed that its pivotal VALOR-CKD Phase 3 trial failed its primary endpoint, with a hazard ratio of 0.99 and p-value of 0.898, contemporaneous with the detected price-volume break.
adjudication_note: The official trial failure is the causal event; the price-volume row is only a discovery proxy and must not become an independent hard label.

evidence_summary: American Rebel issued 3,218,299 round-lot top-up shares after its one-for-100 reverse split had left roughly 247,279 publicly held shares, producing an immediate multi-fold share-count expansion around the detected price break.
adjudication_note: The material event is the disclosed top-up issuance in a repeated-split and listing-compliance chain; exclude the one-day price crash as an independent training event.

evidence_summary: LINKBANCORP's completed bank merger converted each eligible common share into 0.1350 Burke & Herbert common shares, with cash paid only for fractional shares, before Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: Holders received listed acquirer shares; the exchange exit is merger mechanics, not an adverse delisting.

evidence_summary: Blue Star Foods received a Nasdaq panel delisting decision for violating the minimum-bid-price requirement, not for filing bankruptcy or entering liquidation.
adjudication_note: The filing proves a listing event only; reject the bankruptcy/liquidation detector family.

evidence_summary: Altamira Therapeutics transitioned from Nasdaq to OTCQB after minimum-bid-price pressure and stated that OTCQB continuity removed the need for a reverse split.
adjudication_note: The source contains no insolvency proceeding; preserve it as a bankruptcy-detector mismatch control.

evidence_summary: Golden Entertainment's transaction paid a $2.75-per-share distribution and converted each remaining share into 0.902 buyer shares before the company requested Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: Explicit cash and stock consideration make the delisting a transaction-control example rather than an adverse exit.

evidence_item: Offering; Dilution; Recent Developments
evidence_summary: Before UTime's one-for-100 reverse split, it completed an August private placement of 80 million shares for $25 million and priced 22,727,275 additional units with warrants permitting up to 318,181,850 zero-exercise-price shares.
adjudication_note: The A boundary comes from the completed 80 million-share financing and priced zero-price-warrant structure; the later split is only a chain consequence and does not independently create A++ or S.

evidence_item: Offering; Warrants; Recent Developments
evidence_summary: Ahead of Yueda Digital's one-for-100 consolidation, an 80,826,225-share-and-warrant offering had closed for approximately $180 million and a new 28 million-unit offering carried zero-price warrants for a fixed 364 million shares.
adjudication_note: The hard signal is the closed share issuance plus the priced zero-exercise-price warrant chain; exclude the mechanical consolidation as an independent hard label.

evidence_item: Share Consolidation Proposal
evidence_summary: Meihua International approved a proportional one-for-100 consolidation with fractional shares rounded up, followed by a large authorized-capital increase; the reviewed contemporaneous evidence does not establish a priced or realized financing.
adjudication_note: Authorized capacity and a later failed listing cure do not prove realized dilution at the split event time; keep this as a B boundary.

evidence_summary: SunOpta's court-approved arrangement transferred every common share to the purchaser for $6.50 cash before Nasdaq and TSX delisting.
adjudication_note: The exchange exits followed paid acquisition consideration and are not adverse delisting events.

evidence_summary: ESH Acquisition elected not to complete a business combination and redeemed every public share for its pro rata portion of the trust account before Nasdaq delisting.
adjudication_note: Public holders receive their pro rata trust redemption; this is an ordinary SPAC lifecycle control, not a negative common-equity death label.

evidence_item: Share Consolidation
evidence_summary: WORK Medical's first one-for-100 consolidation was implemented to address Nasdaq minimum-bid and low-priced-stock requirements; the contemporaneous filing itself describes a proportional listing-remediation action.
adjudication_note: The first split is a B-grade compliance action at event time; the later 118-fold re-expansion and second split carry the chain's A assessment, so this earlier member is excluded from independent hard-label training.

evidence_summary: LuxUrban Hotels' Nasdaq panel delisting followed noncompliance with periodic filing, minimum-bid and other continued-listing rules, not a bankruptcy or liquidation filing.
adjudication_note: The primary filing supports a listing-compliance event only; reject the bankruptcy/liquidation detector family.

evidence_summary: Leafly's Nasdaq panel delisting followed failure to satisfy continued-listing financial and bid-price requirements; the reviewed filing does not disclose an insolvency petition.
adjudication_note: A serious exchange exit is not automatically bankruptcy; preserve the detector mismatch as a negative control.

evidence_summary: Pearl Holdings Acquisition was suspended and made subject to Nasdaq delisting because the SPAC had not completed a business combination within 36 months of its IPO effectiveness.
adjudication_note: The event is a SPAC exchange-rule deadline failure with possible OTC continuity, not bankruptcy or liquidation.

evidence_summary: CF Acquisition Corp. VII became subject to Nasdaq delisting after failing to complete its initial business combination within the required 36-month SPAC period.
adjudication_note: The filing proves a SPAC deadline/listing event rather than an insolvency proceeding.

evidence_summary: Lion Electric applied for creditor protection under Canada's CCAA, intended to seek U.S. Chapter 15 recognition, requested a creditor stay and DIP financing, and launched a formal sale and investment solicitation process after senior-debt defaults.
adjudication_note: The filed creditor-protection proceeding and DIP/SISP process establish A++, but no reviewed plan or court order establishes cancellation or zero recovery for old common equity, so S is not proven.

evidence_summary: Akoustis and subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 cases, began a court-supervised Section 363 asset sale and stated that they did not expect common or other equity holders to receive a payment or distribution.
adjudication_note: The filed case, asset sale and explicit expected-zero-recovery statement establish A++, but expectation is not a confirmed plan or effective cancellation order and therefore does not prove S.

evidence_summary: The Container Store's December 9 NYSE suspension followed failure to maintain the required $15 million 30-day average global market capitalization; the company did not file Chapter 11 until December 22.
adjudication_note: Reject the December 9 bankruptcy label: the contemporaneous event was a market-cap listing failure. The later filing and terminal cancellation are separate events and must not be backfilled onto this earlier date.

evidence_summary: The Container Store's confirmed Chapter 11 plan became effective on January 28, 2025 and all previously issued equity interests were cancelled, released and extinguished without consideration or distributions.
adjudication_note: This independently discovered terminal event is dated to plan effectiveness, not the earlier delisting. Court confirmation, effectiveness and explicit zero consideration satisfy the S legal-finality boundary without future leakage.

evidence_summary: At its one-for-100 split, Q/C Technologies left 1.25 billion common shares authorized and disclosed a definitive $7 million Series H preferred placement initially convertible into 1.4 million post-split shares with warrants for another 1.4 million shares, plus acquisition consideration in Series I preferred convertible at $0.001 subject to issuance caps and approval.
adjudication_note: The A assessment comes from disclosed definitive preferred and warrant financing plus post-split issuance capacity. The proportional split alone is not an A label and is excluded as an independent training proxy.

evidence_summary: Addentax closed a $25 million underwritten public offering of 5 million common shares, equal to about 19.2% of the 26.093 million shares outstanding shortly before the offering.
adjudication_note: A completed roughly 19% share issuance is a real financing event, but it does not meet the extreme-dilution A boundary. The later price crash is retained as a consequence, not as causal truth.

evidence_summary: Safeguard Scientifics voluntarily left Nasdaq and planned Exchange Act deregistration while seeking continued OTC quotation and pursuing a multi-year monetization of its ownership interests with projected cost savings.
adjudication_note: This is a genuine voluntary listing exit with reduced disclosure and liquidity, but intended OTC continuity and no forced insolvency cause keep it at B.

evidence_summary: LanzaTech implemented a one-for-100 split to regain minimum-bid compliance and increased authorized shares from 600 million to 2.58 billion immediately before the split, producing 25.8 million post-split authorized shares rather than a purely proportional 6 million.
adjudication_note: The event expands issuance capacity relative to a proportional adjustment but proves no contemporaneous priced or realized financing; retain B and do not infer A from split ratio.

evidence_summary: Bollinger Innovations effected a one-for-100 split that reduced about 79.9 million outstanding shares to about 798,650 while leaving the authorized common-share count unchanged.
adjudication_note: Unreduced authorization creates large issuance capacity, but this filing proves only the proportional split and no executed financing. Keep the event at B pending separate realized issuance evidence.

evidence_summary: Movella voluntarily filed to leave Nasdaq and expected its common shares and warrants to be quoted by OTC Markets, while warning that an OTC trading market was not assured.
adjudication_note: The official filing proves a voluntary liquidity and venue downgrade, not a merger, bankruptcy or common-equity death event.

evidence_summary: Broad Capital disclosed termination of its proposed SPAC business combination with Openmarkets Group; the reviewed filing contains no bankruptcy or liquidation proceeding.
adjudication_note: A terminated SPAC merger is not an insolvency filing; preserve this as a hard negative for the bankruptcy detector.

evidence_summary: TFF Pharmaceuticals' board unanimously approved dissolution and liquidation subject to stockholder approval, terminated the license underlying its historic platform, eliminated substantially all employees and installed a wind-down specialist as its sole director and executive.
adjudication_note: Board approval, loss of the core license and near-total workforce elimination establish A++; shareholder approval and a terminal old-common outcome were not yet final, so S is not assigned.

evidence_summary: Perception Capital III was delisted after failing to complete a SPAC business combination by its Nasdaq panel deadline and elected not to seek further review.
adjudication_note: The primary cause is a SPAC transaction deadline/listing failure, not a bankruptcy petition or court-supervised liquidation.

evidence_summary: CareMax and affiliates filed Chapter 11 petitions, entered a restructuring support agreement contemplating cancellation of all existing equity and warned of significant or complete investor loss.
adjudication_note: The filed cases and agreed restructuring support A++, but the November filing only contemplated later cancellation. The terminal S event is separately dated to plan effectiveness.

evidence_summary: CareMax's confirmed plan became effective, discharged and cancelled every existing equity interest and explicitly provided no recovery, distribution or compensation to old common holders.
adjudication_note: Court confirmation, plan effectiveness and explicit zero recovery satisfy the S boundary. This event is stored on February 3 and is not backfilled to the November Chapter 11 candidate.

evidence_summary: Mondee did not file Chapter 11 until January 14, 2025, more than a month after the December 5 candidate date; the later case included a Section 363 sale and expected significant or complete common-holder loss.
adjudication_note: Do not backfill the January bankruptcy onto a December price or metadata candidate. The actual filing is represented as a separate manually discovered event.

evidence_summary: Mondee and subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions, entered a DIP-supported Section 363 sale process and warned that common holders should expect significant or complete loss.
adjudication_note: The actual petition date supports A++. No reviewed confirmation order or effective cancellation establishes zero recovery with legal finality, so S is not assigned.

evidence_item: Listing compliance
evidence_summary: Chanson's annual report stated that it had already regained minimum-bid compliance after an 80-for-one consolidation; the reviewed evidence contains no contemporaneous adverse cause for the April 30 price observation.
adjudication_note: The later May financing and split chain is separately adjudicated and cannot be backfilled onto this April price date.

evidence_item: Material Change Report
evidence_summary: Alithya voluntarily ended its Nasdaq dual listing to reduce fees and management burden while its Class A shares continued trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
adjudication_note: The venue exit reduces U.S. liquidity but preserves primary TSX trading and is not a forced delisting or equity-death event.

evidence_summary: Constellation Acquisition voluntarily left the NYSE after board approval and intended to seek quotation of its shares, units and warrants on OTCQX.
adjudication_note: The official filing supports a voluntary venue downgrade with intended OTC continuity, not bankruptcy or common-equity cancellation.

evidence_summary: Before Digital Ally's May one-for-100 reverse split, it closed 100 million common or pre-funded units at about $0.15, each carrying both a Series A and Series B warrant; the split left authorized capital unchanged.
adjudication_note: The A boundary comes from the completed 100 million-unit and double-warrant financing, not the later proportional split; keep the split proxy out of independent training.

evidence_item: Reverse Stock Split
evidence_summary: Blue Hat announced a one-for-100 reverse split and later confirmed that it regained Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance; the reviewed filings do not establish a contemporaneous priced financing.
adjudication_note: A compliance split without executed financing remains B; ratio alone does not establish dilution severity.

evidence_item: Recent Developments; Selling Stockholders
evidence_summary: After Conduit's one-for-100 split reduced outstanding shares to about 1.80 million, its resale registration covered up to 5.8 million shares from a convertible note plus warrants and other issuances, against about 2.12 million shares outstanding at filing.
adjudication_note: The material signal is the note and resale overhang relative to post-split shares, not the split itself; financing magnitude alone does not imply A++ or S.

evidence_summary: ENGlobal's Nasdaq delisting followed failure to regain compliance with the minimum stockholders' equity rule; the reviewed filing contains no bankruptcy petition.
adjudication_note: A serious listing failure is not proof of a court insolvency process; preserve the mismatch as a detector control.

evidence_item: Liquidity and credit facility
evidence_summary: Virco reported no outstanding credit-facility borrowings, compliance with all financial covenants and sufficient cash, operating cash flow and unused capacity for at least twelve months.
adjudication_note: A mechanically negative quarterly EBIT-to-interest ratio is not distress when there are no borrowings, covenants are satisfied and liquidity is sufficient.

evidence_item: Liquidity and debt
evidence_summary: ServiceTitan reported $421.5 million cash, $250 million unused revolving capacity, full repayment of its term loan and no outstanding indebtedness at April 30, 2026.
adjudication_note: The detector divided a period result by accounting interest while the company had repaid debt and held large liquidity; no debt-service distress exists.

evidence_item: Offering; Dilution
evidence_summary: AgriFORCE sold 16 million shares at $0.05 against roughly 84.3 million shares outstanding and maintained an ATM program and convertible debenture overhang before its December one-for-100 split.
adjudication_note: The completed issuance was about 19% of pre-offering shares and does not independently meet the extreme-dilution A boundary; unexecuted ATM capacity is not realized dilution.

evidence_summary: AIM ImmunoTech effected a one-for-100 reverse split and subsequently regained NYSE American low-selling-price compliance; no contemporaneous financing is established in the reviewed filing.
adjudication_note: The official filing proves listing remediation only; do not infer dilution severity from the one-for-100 ratio.

evidence_summary: Gaucho Group Holdings filed a voluntary Chapter 11 petition in the Southern District of Florida; reviewed evidence establishes the court case but not a terminal old-common cancellation or zero-recovery outcome.
adjudication_note: A filed Chapter 11 case supports A++, but no reviewed confirmation or effective cancellation proves common-equity death, so S is prohibited.

evidence_summary: GlycoMimetics completed a reverse recapitalization with Crescent, a one-for-100 split and a $200 million pre-closing financing; legacy GlycoMimetics holders retained about 2.7% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis.
adjudication_note: The material event is the completed ownership transfer and financing, not the proportional split. It is a severe recapitalization but not insolvency or zero recovery.

evidence_summary: Soon after Zoomcar's one-for-100 split, it closed a $9.15 million placement of 1,302,850 shares and 835,000 pre-funded warrants, with reset-linked warrant coverage capable of expanding far beyond the post-split share base.
adjudication_note: The financing and reset-warrant overhang establish A; the reverse split is a linked discovery proxy and is not an independent negative label.

evidence_item: Voluntary delisting notice
evidence_summary: illumin voluntarily ended its Nasdaq dual listing because most trading already occurred in Canada and costs were not justified; its common shares continued trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
adjudication_note: This is a venue and cost decision with home-market continuity, not a forced delisting or common-equity death.

evidence_item: ADS deregistration
evidence_summary: Banco Itau Chile terminated its U.S. ADR program and Exchange Act reporting for ADSs while the underlying Chilean common shares and domestic banking franchise continued.
adjudication_note: The U.S. security channel ended, but the operating bank and local shares continued; preserve this as a B boundary.

evidence_summary: Expion360 effected a one-for-100 reverse split specifically to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance, with proportional treatment of outstanding common shares and no contemporaneous financing in the reviewed filing.
adjudication_note: A large split ratio does not establish dilution without a realized financing chain; retain B.

evidence_item: Nasdaq delisting notice
evidence_summary: Polyrizon's material primary event was Nasdaq's May 21 discretionary delisting determination; the June 4 price-crash candidate occurs later and is only a market consequence proxy.
adjudication_note: The actual May 21 event is separately represented. Do not train the later price path as a second event or move the official fact to the price date.

evidence_item: Nasdaq Listing Rule 5101 notice
evidence_summary: Nasdaq staff issued Polyrizon a May 21 discretionary delisting determination under Listing Rule 5101; the company could appeal and the notice did not itself immediately terminate trading.
adjudication_note: The official notice is a serious forced-listing event, but it remained appealable and was not bankruptcy, security cancellation or a terminal equity outcome.

evidence_summary: EVe Mobility disclosed delayed SEC filings and a SPAC business-combination deadline under NYSE American listing standards; no bankruptcy petition or court-supervised liquidation was reported.
adjudication_note: A SPAC listing deadline is not evidence of bankruptcy; preserve the ACTIONS-family mismatch as a hard negative.

evidence_summary: Gores Holdings IX elected ordinary SPAC wind-up mechanics, redeeming public shares for their pro-rata cash trust value and later delisting; this was not a bankruptcy case.
adjudication_note: Public holders received cash from the trust account; do not equate corporate liquidation terminology with insolvent common-equity death.

evidence_item: SPAC extension and listing consequences
evidence_summary: Everest Consolidator sought an extension beyond the NYSE SPAC 36-month limit and disclosed resulting suspension and delisting while public holders retained redemption rights; no bankruptcy filing occurred.
adjudication_note: The event is a SPAC deadline/listing mechanism with trust redemption rights, not a court insolvency proceeding.

evidence_summary: DUET Acquisition's listing problem concerned failure to meet Nasdaq's minimum market value of listed securities and a panel review; the filing contains no bankruptcy petition.
adjudication_note: A listing-standard failure is not a bankruptcy event and must remain a detector control.

evidence_summary: bleuacacia was delisted after its SPAC failed to complete an initial business combination within Nasdaq's 36-month deadline; no bankruptcy petition was filed.
adjudication_note: Nasdaq's SPAC clock is a listing rule, not evidence of insolvency or common-equity cancellation.

evidence_summary: Mountain Crest Acquisition V was delisted solely because it did not complete a SPAC business combination within 36 months; it expected continued OTC trading and did not report bankruptcy.
adjudication_note: The official filing proves a Nasdaq SPAC deadline and expected OTC continuity, not a liquidation under bankruptcy law.

evidence_item: Nasdaq delisting notice
evidence_summary: Polyrizon's June 3 price-crash row is a one-day sibling of the June 4 price proxy and follows the same May 21 Nasdaq discretionary delisting determination.
adjudication_note: Collapse adjacent market observations into one crisis thread and keep the actual May 21 official notice as the only primary event.

evidence_item: Voluntary delisting announcement
evidence_summary: voxeljet voluntarily delisted its Nasdaq ADSs after concluding that listing benefits did not justify the costs and management burden and that exiting would support its financial position.
adjudication_note: The company chose a cost-saving listing exit; the evidence does not establish a forced delisting, insolvency filing or terminal common-equity outcome.

evidence_item: Secondary listing discontinuation
evidence_summary: Natura approved discontinuing its secondary NYSE listing to simplify operations while its primary common-share listing continued on B3 in Sao Paulo.
adjudication_note: This is a dual-listing consolidation with home-market continuity, not corporate failure or destruction of the underlying common equity.

evidence_item: Voluntary delisting announcement
evidence_summary: Minerva Surgical voluntarily chose to delist and deregister to reduce cash burn, expenses and management burden and warned that its common shares would become less liquid.
adjudication_note: Cash conservation and reduced liquidity are material but remain a voluntary going-dark event without a court process or proven zero recovery.

evidence_item: Voluntary delisting announcement
evidence_summary: Citizens Holding voluntarily left Nasdaq for significant cost savings and expected its common stock to continue trading on OTCQX with continuing audited and quarterly information.
adjudication_note: The security retained an expected public OTCQX venue and financial reporting; this is a cost-driven venue change, not equity death.

evidence_item: ADS delisting and termination
evidence_summary: Aenza voluntarily ended its NYSE ADS listing and ADR program to consolidate liquidity while its common shares continued on the Lima Stock Exchange.
adjudication_note: The U.S. ADS channel ended but the underlying home-market common shares continued; preserve this as a venue boundary.

evidence_summary: Bank of South Carolina voluntarily left Nasdaq and deregistered to reduce costs while expecting uninterrupted common-stock trading on OTCQX.
adjudication_note: The issuer deliberately changed venues for cost reasons with expected trading continuity; no forced-listing or terminal-equity fact is present.

evidence_summary: The official record identifies a June 6, 2023 NYSE low-price delisting determination, not a new voluntary-delisting event on the Sharadar row's February 15, 2024 date.
adjudication_note: Reject the later voluntary-delisting label and preserve the actual forced exchange determination as a separately dated manual event.

evidence_summary: NYSE Regulation determined to delist Evolve because of its prolonged abnormally low selling price despite a planned one-for-30 split; the company intended to request review.
adjudication_note: The exchange determination is serious and forced but reviewable; it does not prove insolvency, security cancellation or zero recovery.

evidence_summary: European Wax Center's Nasdaq delisting followed completion of its General Atlantic take-private, with each eligible Class A share converted into $5.80 cash.
adjudication_note: The delisting is mechanical completion of a cash acquisition with stated consideration, not an adverse listing or solvency event.

evidence_item: Judicial management and Nasdaq determination
evidence_summary: The April 30 Sharadar delisting row is a later proxy for Maxeon's separately dated April 1 judicial-management application and April 24 Nasdaq delisting determination.
adjudication_note: Do not shift the court-process or exchange-notice date to a downstream vendor action date; represent both primary events separately.

evidence_item: Singapore judicial-management application
evidence_summary: Maxeon and a subsidiary applied to the Singapore High Court for judicial management under IRDA after identifying significant doubts about sufficient working capital.
adjudication_note: Judicial management is a court-supervised insolvency rescue process supporting A++, but no reviewed terminal old-common cancellation permits S.

evidence_item: Singapore interim judicial-management order
evidence_summary: The official filing places the interim judicial-management order on April 9, 2026; the April 30 Sharadar row is a later temporal proxy for that already separately represented legal status change.
adjudication_note: Keep the April 9 court order as the primary event and do not train the April 30 vendor date as a duplicate insolvency label.

evidence_item: Singapore interim judicial-management order
evidence_summary: The Singapore High Court placed Maxeon and a subsidiary under interim judicial management on April 9, appointed Deloitte restructuring professionals and transferred management authority from directors and officers.
adjudication_note: The court order is a genuine legal status change after the application, but still does not prove terminal cancellation or zero recovery for old common equity.

evidence_item: Nasdaq delisting determination
evidence_summary: Nasdaq staff issued Maxeon an April 24 delisting determination after the judicial-management application and interim order; the company retained an appeal route.
adjudication_note: This is the separately dated exchange consequence of the judicial-management process; it is appealable and not itself a terminal equity outcome.

evidence_item: Reverse split announcement
evidence_summary: American Rebel effected a one-for-100 reverse split for Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance, with proportional derivative adjustments but unusually large round-lot protection shares represented separately in the financing and issuance event.
adjudication_note: Keep the proportional split at B and the separately proven round-lot share issuance at A; do not double-count one recapitalization chain.

evidence_item: Share consolidation announcement
evidence_summary: Chijet announced a one-for-100 consolidation of issued and unissued Class A and Class B ordinary shares that affected holders uniformly and did not alter percentage ownership.
adjudication_note: The official announcement proves a proportional capital adjustment; no contemporaneous realized financing or ownership transfer is established.

evidence_item: Liquidity; Credit facility covenants
evidence_summary: Mission Produce reported $611.6 million of equity, $135.1 million of working capital and compliance with all leverage and fixed-charge covenants; first-half operating cash usage was seasonal rather than a debt-service failure.
adjudication_note: A formula ratio below one is not a distress event when fixed-charge covenants are met, equity and working capital are positive and cash use is seasonally explained.

evidence_item: Going concern; Liquidity and capital resources
evidence_summary: Gloo reported $33.0 million cash, $34.9 million debt including $17.8 million current, no borrowing capacity, $17.1 million quarterly operating cash burn and unresolved substantial doubt dependent on future capital.
adjudication_note: The material event is unresolved financing-dependent going concern risk, not the mechanical interest-coverage ratio; cash remains and no court or terminal equity fact supports A++ or S.

evidence_item: Liquidity and capital resources
evidence_summary: FuelCell Energy held $373.2 million of unrestricted cash and concluded that cash, contracted receipts and restricted-cash releases would meet obligations for at least one year, despite longer-term financing dependence.
adjudication_note: The business remains financing-dependent over the long term, but the filing expressly supports twelve-month liquidity and does not report substantial doubt or current debt-service failure.

evidence_item: Liquidity and credit covenants
evidence_summary: Bridgford had $0.83 million cash, recurring losses and negative operating cash flow, violated net-income and quick-ratio covenants that required waivers and had only $0.5 million remaining revolver capacity at quarter end.
adjudication_note: The official filing establishes real covenant breaches and tight liquidity, upgrading the mechanical ratio signal to A; lender waivers and remaining assets keep it below A++.

evidence_item: Liquidity; Debt covenants; Stockholders' deficit
evidence_summary: Jack in the Box's $922.1 million stockholders' deficit included $3.2 billion of treasury stock, while it reported $69.4 million cash and restricted cash, $95.3 million borrowing availability, twelve-month liquidity sufficiency and full covenant compliance.
adjudication_note: Negative book equity is factual but not an insolvency label when treasury stock explains the deficit and liquidity and debt covenants remain adequate.

evidence_item: Going concern; Credit agreement
evidence_summary: Sleep Number expected covenant noncompliance within twelve months, concluded operating cash and credit availability would be insufficient, and said lender negotiations and capital or strategic alternatives did not alleviate substantial going-concern doubt.
adjudication_note: The company states that ordinary operations and existing credit are insufficient and resolution depends on lenders, new capital or strategic alternatives; no bankruptcy filing or terminal common treatment permits S.

evidence_item: Liquidity and capital resources; Stockholders' deficit
evidence_summary: Shimmick reported stockholders' deficit but also $34 million total liquidity, positive adjusted EBITDA and no substantial-doubt conclusion; it continued to monitor outside capital for growth and planned expenditures.
adjudication_note: Negative equity and dependence on access to capital merit context, but current liquidity, operating improvement and absence of substantial doubt keep the event at B.

evidence_summary: Tonix effected a one-for-100 reverse split for Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance; outstanding securities adjusted proportionally, authorized common shares remained unchanged and no contemporaneous completed financing is established in the reviewed filing.
adjudication_note: Unreduced authorized capacity is an overhang, not realized dilution. Without a contemporaneous completed issuance the split remains B.

evidence_item: Reverse stock split
evidence_summary: Apollomics confirmed a one-for-100 reverse split completed November 25, 2024 after shareholder approval to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance, without a contemporaneous realized financing in the reviewed evidence.
adjudication_note: The completed split is a listing-compliance event. Earlier or later financing is not moved onto the split date without a contemporaneous realized issuance chain.

evidence_item: 100-for-1 reverse split; realized convertible-note and warrant financing
evidence_summary: Zeta Network's predecessor effected a one-for-100 reverse split on November 15 after selling approximately $7.6 million of variable-price convertible notes and 2,853,118 warrants; the filing also showed only 842,853 nonaffiliate shares after the split and a simultaneous expansion to 280 billion authorized Class A shares.
adjudication_note: The grade rests on the completed September note-and-warrant sale, immediate conversion mechanics and post-split issuance capacity. The separately described additional $40 million of notes had not yet been sold and is excluded from realized dilution.

evidence_item: 1-for-100 reverse split; contemporaneous debt and preferred-stock conversions
evidence_summary: Interactive Strength reduced outstanding common shares from 41,787,040 to 417,871 in a one-for-100 split, reset a $4.0 million secured convertible note to $4.79 per share and, from November 11 through 13, issued 41,754 note-conversion shares plus 116,604 Series A conversion shares, about 38% of the initial post-split common base.
adjudication_note: The split is linked to realized same-week debt and preferred conversions, not merely future financing capacity. A separate November 13 exchange issued another 31,538 shares for a $512,500 loan reduction; no terminal common-equity fact supports A++ or S.

evidence_item: Nasdaq public-holder deficiency; SPAC trust redemption
evidence_summary: Qomolangma was suspended after Nasdaq found it below the 300-public-holder requirement and the company declined to appeal; it later announced approximately $10.88-per-share trust redemption after abandoning a business combination, with no bankruptcy petition or court liquidation.
adjudication_note: The November vendor bankruptcy/liquidation label conflates a Nasdaq listing deficiency with a later ordinary SPAC wind-down. Public holders received trust cash; preserve this as a hard bankruptcy false-positive control.

evidence_item: Trading market; Going concern
evidence_summary: Charlie's Holdings stated that its common stock already traded on the OTCQB Venture Market under CHUC; the filing discussed operating losses and going-concern risk but did not disclose a new voluntary exchange delisting on November 14, 2023.
adjudication_note: Do not convert a going-concern discussion into a delisting event. Any fundamental distress must be dated and reviewed separately from this false corporate-action row.

evidence_item: Trading market
evidence_summary: Clearday identified CLRD as trading on OTCQX in its October 2023 quarterly filing; its predecessor had already been delisted from Nasdaq in September 2020, so the October 31, 2023 voluntary-delisting row is not a new legal or exchange event.
adjudication_note: The security was already off Nasdaq and trading OTC well before the candidate date; do not train a stale vendor action as a fresh delisting event.

evidence_item: 1-for-20 share consolidation
evidence_summary: VCI Global announced a one-for-20 share consolidation for Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance, effective April 3, 2025; the company had also closed a 5.1 million-share offering on March 18, equal to about 9% of the pre-split share base.
adjudication_note: The corporate action is real and was announced before the price candidate, but the price row is one day before the effective split date. Keep the event while excluding this detector timestamp from exact-date hard-label training.

evidence_item: Section 12(j) proceeding and same-day trading suspension
evidence_summary: The SEC instituted a Section 12(j) proceeding against THT Heat Transfer Technology and separately suspended trading on August 24 because required periodic reports had been delinquent since November 2018. The September 16 price row did not identify a new official event.
adjudication_note: Reject the September detector date and represent the actual August 24 regulatory event separately as MANUAL-SEC-THTI-20200824-SECTION12J-PROCEEDING.

evidence_item: company response to market volatility
evidence_summary: Agape ATP stated that operations continued as usual and that it was not aware of any material undisclosed corporate development or adverse condition explaining the recent market volatility.
adjudication_note: A price move is not a corporate event. The subsequent official response is useful negative evidence and does not justify inventing a hidden cause.

evidence_item: later share and pre-funded-warrant offering
evidence_summary: Erayak priced a 12.396 million-share and 18.216 million pre-funded-warrant offering on July 25, four days after the July 21 price candidate. The later financing cannot be used as a backward-looking explanation for the earlier detector row.
adjudication_note: Do not attach a future financing to an earlier price move. RAYA's later financing and September split chain are represented on their own dates.

evidence_item: response to speculative third-party article
evidence_summary: Pheton confirmed that a July 29 Bear Cave article circulated speculative acquisition-manipulation allegations and publicly denied involvement in false Gilead acquisition rumors or market manipulation.
adjudication_note: This is a verified information event, not verified corporate misconduct or a completed acquisition. Retain it as a C-grade rumor/correction boundary and never promote the article's allegations to fact.

evidence_item: 100-for-1 ordinary-share consolidation and 5-for-1 ADS consolidation
evidence_summary: Genetic Technologies announced a 100-for-1 ordinary-share consolidation and an ADS ratio change that required five old ADSs to be exchanged for one new ADS, effective on the December 14 candidate date.
adjudication_note: The candidate date exactly matches first consolidated trading. No contemporaneous financing or common-equity death fact supports a grade above B.

evidence_item: NYSE suspension and delisting history
evidence_summary: Amira Nature Foods disclosed that NYSE trading had been suspended on August 18, 2020 because of filing delinquency and that the security was delisted. No new issuer filing or exchange action supports the November 29, 2021 price candidate.
adjudication_note: The known exchange event was more than a year earlier. Preserve the 2021 row only as a negative temporal control.

evidence_item: 1-for-60 reverse split; acquisition financing and reset-linked share adjustment
evidence_summary: Healthcare Triangle effected a one-for-60 reverse split on February 10, reducing 45.4 million shares to about 757 thousand while authorized shares remained unchanged. A recently closed acquisition had issued common stock and $18 million of convertible preferred stock and included a pre-funded-warrant and post-split price-reset share adjustment.
adjudication_note: The A grade belongs to the realized acquisition-equity and reset mechanism chain, not to a reverse split by itself. No terminal old-common outcome supports A++ or S.

evidence_item: February and March pre-funded-warrant closings
evidence_summary: Eloxx's May 5 quarterly report documented February and March pre-funded-warrant issuances for cash and debt extinguishment, but those transactions predated the May 12 price row by months. The realized financing chain is represented separately on its actual date.
